1953, February 7
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F. M. Cap.
Feast SS. Fabian and Sebastian (Jan. 20) Blessed be God in all His designs in every thing!
My Dear Brother, Father Edward:
God Bless us all - - Yourself and myself and all our friends and honest enemies if such there be. More than six weeks ago, having read your letter I started to respond at once . God help us! I just got started and here we have Sexigesima. Thanks be to God! though we've had quite a little grippe-weather the last three months, we so far, have had but one case of that epidemic.
Up in Detroit since Wednesday, I just returned . . finding 3 full sets of the Mystical City of God in our Cell (% Wallace Bedolfe who was here over night about a week ago) Miss Doris Panyard of 1705 Peck Street Muskegan, Michigan just phoned me that he requested four sets -- one for himself. Deo gratias! -- a promising 23 yr. oldster who was baptised as was his elder Br. Bob and Sister Barbara. No doubt Grace has told you about them
Fr. Solanus, O. F. M. Cap.
2/7/53
(On reverse side-picture card of St. Felix Friary. On bottom Fr. Solanus wrote the following:)
Air View. St. Felix Friary - - Victory Noll overlooking the Wabash in distant rear --- left. Headq's of the Missionary Catechists. We think this snapped by a local Minister who is said to have a hobby in such.
